title: Eleven
statementMd:
Eleven wants to choose a new name for herself. As a bunch of geeks, her friends suggested an algorithm to choose a name for her. Eleven wants her name to have exactly $*n*$ characters.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b17e090ebd76d0a8a21e176ebd7cfb297cbc8ec.png)

Her friend suggested that her name should only consist of uppercase and lowercase letters '`O`'. More precisely, they suggested that the $*i*$-th letter of her name should be '`O`' (uppercase) if $*i*$ is a member of Fibonacci sequence, and '`o`' (lowercase) otherwise. The letters in the name are numbered from $1$ to $*n*$. Fibonacci sequence is the sequence $*f*$ where

- $*f*_{1} = 1$,
- $*f*_{2} = 1$,
- $*f*_{*n*} = *f*_{*n* - 2} + *f*_{*n* - 1}$ ($*n* > 2$).

As her friends are too young to know what Fibonacci sequence is, they asked you to help Eleven determine her new name.

## Input

The first and only line of input contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$).

## Output

Print Eleven's new name on the first and only line of output.
statementZhMd:
Eleven 想为自己选择一个新名字。作为一群极客，她的朋友们建议使用一种算法来为她选择名字。Eleven 希望自己的名字恰好有 $*n*$ 个字符。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b17e090ebd76d0a8a21e176ebd7cfb297cbc8ec.png)

她的朋友建议，她的名字只能由大写和小写字母 '`O`' 组成。更准确地说，他们建议：如果 $*i*$ 是斐波那契数列中的一个成员，那么她名字的第 $*i*$ 个字母应为 '`O`'（大写）；否则应为 '`o`'（小写）。名字中的字母编号从 $1$ 到 $*n*$。斐波那契数列是数列 $*f*$，定义如下：

- $*f*_{1} = 1$；
- $*f*_{2} = 1$；
- $*f*_{*n*} = *f*_{*n* - 2} + *f*_{*n* - 1}$（$*n* > 2$）。

由于她的朋友们年纪太小，还不知道什么是斐波那契数列，所以他们请你帮助 Eleven 确定她的新名字。

## 输入格式

输入的唯一一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 1000$）。

## 输出格式

在输出的唯一一行中打印 Eleven 的新名字。
